en.title: Two-week snow outlook in Montenegro: 11 cm and 22 cm
en.description: Two-week snow outlook in Montenegro: 11 cm and 22 cm. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Montenegro on 16 November.
en.lede: The first week could bring up to 11 cm to the snowiest slopes in Montenegro, the second up to 22 cm.

p: Two weeks out, the trend counts more than the totals: it tells you whether to book now or wait for the next storm.
80 km² of snow-covered ground in Montenegro this Monday, down 50 km² on yesterday. That is 1 % of the high ground we map in Montenegro.
Over the next three days up to 0 cm is expected, and up to 15 cm over the week.
Monday 23 November stands out, with up to 9 cm in a day.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 22 cm on the snowiest slopes.
At the top of the list, Ski centar Savin kuk reports 13 cm.
Close behind: Kolašin 1600 (1 cm).
At Ski centar Savin kuk: 15 cm of fresh snow over three days, 4 cm more expected by Thursday 19 November.
At Kolašin 1600: 3 cm of fresh snow over three days, 0 cm more expected by Thursday 19 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 2 out of 3 resorts in Montenegro.

sections.h: How deep it is, height by height
p: Height makes the difference: between 1,500 and 2,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 1 % covered; between 2,000 and 2,500 m, 2 cm on average, 49 % covered.
The snow line sits near 2,100 m. Mild days have cost 310 km² since the 390 km² of a week ago.

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: Three-day totals peak at 4 cm, around the Prokletije, Durmitor and Bjelasica.
At least 5 cm fell over some 70 km².

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Bosnia and Herzegovina: 2 % white, deepest Skijalište Kozara with 24 cm, up to 15 cm in the week ahead; Albania: 1 % white, deepest Ski Pista Bigëll with 0 cm, up to 16 cm in the week ahead.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Between 2,000 m and 2,500 m the cover is patchy, about 49 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 2,000 m the slopes are still almost bare.
Little new snow is expected in the next three days, so today's picture should hold for a weekend trip.
The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.

advice: Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.

cnr.title: Koliko snijega ima u Crnoj Gori? Snježni pokrivač i prognoza, 16. novembra 2026.
cnr.description: Snijeg u Crnoj Gori 16. novembra: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
cnr.lede: U Crnoj Gori je danas pod snijegom oko 80 km² (ponedjeljak, 16. novembra). To je 50 km² manje nego jučer. To je 1 % planinskog područja u Crnoj Gori koje pratimo.

p: Snježna granica je oko 2.100 m. Prije sedam dana bilo je 390 km²: od tada se otopilo 310 km².
Visina snijega zavisi od nadmorske visine: 1.500–2.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (1 % pod snijegom); 2.000–2.500 m: prosječno 2 cm (49 % pod snijegom).
Trodnevne količine dostižu 4 cm. Najviše: Prokletije, Durmitor i Bjelasica.
Najmanje 5 cm novog snijega leži na oko 70 km².
Otopljenje topi pokrivač: ujutro tvrd snijeg, poslijepodne mokar.
Prednjači Ski centar Savin kuk: 13 cm na gornjem dijelu staza.
Ski-centri sa snijegom na gornjim stazama: 2 od 3.
Slijede: Kolašin 1600 (1 cm).
Ski centar Savin kuk: 15 cm novog snijega za tri dana i do datuma četvrtak, 19. novembra još do 4 cm.
U naredna tri dana očekuje se do 0 cm, a za cijelu sedmicu do 15 cm.
Najsnježniji dan: ponedjeljak, 23. novembra, do 9 cm.

advice: Iznad granice šume vjetar može nanijeti snijeg: oprezno na grebenima.
